about: Short KJV glosses; use Hub concordance for every occurrence.

words.note: Often means self-giving love (caritas), not fundraising. See 1 Corinthians 13.
Usually “manner of life” or conduct, not two people talking (Philippians 1:27).
Often “living” (Hebrews 4:12 — the word is quick and powerful), not fast.
Special possession (Titus 2:14), not odd — God’s own treasured people.
Holy Ghost = Holy Spirit; older English for the same Person (John 14:26).
Often “go before” or meet (1 Thessalonians 4:15), not stop.
Sometimes “allow” (Matthew 19:14 — suffer little children), not only endure pain.
Moral strength or power going out from Christ (Luke 8:46), not only modesty.
Often solid food (Hebrews 5:12), not only animal flesh.
Grain in general (e.g. wheat), not only maize.
Fill or populate (Genesis 1:28), not refill after emptying.
Sometimes overcome or grasp (John 1:5 — darkness comprehended it not).
Private room (Matthew 6:6 — pray to thy Father in secret), not a wardrobe.
Deep inward feeling (Philippians 2:1), not intestines as we stress the word today.
Often “full of care” or anxious (Philippians 4:6 — be careful for nothing).
Share or give (Hebrews 13:16), not only speak.
Body, human nature, or kinship — context decides (John 1:14; Romans 8:5).
Sheol, grave, or Gehenna by context — not always the same place.
Will and inner person, not only emotion — “as he thinketh in his heart” (Proverbs 23:7).
Living being or life (Matthew 16:26); overlaps with heart and spirit by context.
Breath, attitude, unclean spirit, or Holy Spirit — let the verse rule which.
Change of mind that shows in turning — not mere regret (Acts 26:20).
Declared righteous before God by faith (Romans 5:1), not “made perfect in behavior” first.
Set apart for God; positional and growing (1 Corinthians 6:11).
Wrath absorbed; mercy seat reality (Romans 3:25; 1 John 2:2).
Counted to your account (Romans 4 — not the English word, but the idea of reckoned righteousness).
Binding promise God makes and keeps; cut in blood in the old; new in Christ’s blood.
Tent of meeting; God dwelling among a moving camp; shadow of Christ (Hebrews).
Covering of sin; day of atonement; fulfilled in the one sacrifice (Hebrews 10).
Bought back out of bondage (Ephesians 1:7) — price paid.
God’s favor you did not earn (Ephesians 2:8) — not license (Romans 6).
Trust resting on God’s word (Hebrews 11:1) — shown in what you do (James 2).
Deeds; “not of works” for salvation (Ephesians 2:9); “faith without works” dead (James 2).
Often the age, order, or people of earth (John 3:16) — context narrows meaning.
Assembly — local or universal body of Christ (Matthew 16:18).
Overseer; office of care and teaching (1 Timothy 3) — same office as elder in many passages.
Demons, evil spirits (Matthew 8:31) — not cartoon jokes; Christ has authority.
Often fermented drink; “new wine” also; wisdom says beware excess (Proverbs 20:1).
Judgment image (Revelation 14:19) — God’s wrath pressed out.
Building, body of Christ, or believer (1 Corinthians 6:19) — track the referent.
